# absolute R relations

> absolute R relations (ARR) is a New York City public relations agency for beauty, wellness, lifestyle and luxury brands, founded in 2015 by Colleen Mathis. Tagline: The R is for Results.

- Address: 1270 6th Avenue, Suite 711, New York, NY 10020
- Email: colleen@absoluterrelations.com
- Founder and CEO: Colleen Mathis, 20+ years in beauty, lifestyle and luxury PR; former PR Director at a beauty agency; campaigns for Procter & Gamble brands; led PR for the Nathan's Hot Dog Eating Contest
- Team: Erin Daly, Account Executive
- Sister company: Absolute R Productions (photo and video)
- Services: media relations, national TV, influencer seeding (1,000+ creators), events and activations, award strategy, AI-ready PR
- Clients include High On Love, VOESH, Mama Sol, PRIVATES and Local AI Registry
- Clients have been featured in Vogue, ELLE, Harper's BAZAAR, Allure, Marie Claire, InStyle, Glamour, People, W, Town & Country, Brides, NewBeauty, The New York Times, WWD, POPSUGAR, Refinery29, Bustle, NYLON, Byrdie, Forbes, Fashionista, Yahoo and THE TODAY SHOW
- Client retailers: Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Target, Walmart, Amazon, CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, QVC, HSN

## Partner: Local AI Registry
absolute R relations is the PR partner of Local AI Registry (https://localairegistry.com/), an Irvine, California company that gets local businesses named when people ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google where to go. Its offer: named by AI within 90 days, or the team works for free until you are.
- [Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/)
- [90-day AI visibility guarantee](https://localairegistry.com/guarantee)

- [Local AI research](https://localairegistry.com/research)
- [The local answer gap](https://localairegistry.com/research/local-answer-gap)
- [PR for AI visibility](https://localairegistry.com/blueprint/pr)
- [Free AI visibility check](https://audit.localairegistry.com/home/look-up/)
